messages:
maria-cs: FYI — FinEdge just uploaded a CAIQ and asked for KMS/HSM evidence + audit log retention policy. They also reported intermittent 401s yesterday (13:42–13:53 UTC) and a sudden billing spike on the same window. They want final CAIQ answers + artefacts by Friday EOD. Putting this thread for triage.

sam-eng: copying me. can you drop the exact error IDs and example request headers? want to repro the 401 quickly. also, which plan are they on? dedicated or hosted?

maria-cs: they're on hosted API (paid). customer provided one request-id: req_01H8Y2XZ3. timeframe as above. pasted their sample request:

maria-cs: ```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "gptx-small",
  "input": "Hello",
  "client_request_id": "fin-req-20240611"
}
```

alex-security: for the CAIQ/KMS evidence, we can provide the KMS key policy export + HSM attestation summary. I put a draft bundle in S3: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/finedge/2024-06-11/. It includes key policy JSON (sanitized), KMS rotation logs (last 12 months), and HSM cert thumbprints. Note: we should not include raw private key material. I'll prepare a zipped artefact and a short cover letter for the CAIQ answers.

jordan-ps: can we request a 48h extension for the CAIQ delivery? Friday EOD is tight given we need legal to sign off on the KMS statements. I'll ask the AE to confirm; propose Mon EOD.

maria-cs: AE confirmed they can take an extension if we flag any items needing legal review. customer said the 401s are blocking their security review — asked if the 401s indicate data access problems.

sam-eng: initial check: their request-id hits look normal in the proxy logs, but auth service returned 401 for a subset of tokens with header mismatch. I pulled logs for req_01H8Y2XZ3:

sam-eng: ```
[2024-06-11T13:43:12Z] req_01H8Y2XZ3 token=tok_abc status=401 auth_error="signature_mismatch"
[2024-06-11T13:43:12Z] upstream auth-service returned 401 for 3/10 attempts from same IP
```

sam-eng: hypothesis: token refresh race causing old token to be used during short window. Repro steps:
1) create short-lived token (ttl 30s)
2) send parallel requests while rotating token
3) observe intermittent 401s

alex-security: that aligns with a known edge case in our short-ttl flow. We patched the refresh logic in early May for Dedicated customers but missed a hosted rollout for token caching. I'm escalating this to infra. For immediate mitigation, we can advise the customer to increase token TTL to 5m or implement client-side linear backoff for 401 (retry once after 200ms).

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-3423 — "Hosted token refresh race causing intermittent 401 responses". Severity: P2. Assigned: eng-auth.

oncall-bot: Pager duty alert sent to eng-auth oncall.

sam-eng: I'll open a quick hotfix branch to add a server-side tolerant check for tokens within a 2-second clock skew window and coordinate rollback if it causes any regressions. Also capturing metrics for 401-rate pre/post.

maria-cs: thanks. for the CAIQ bundle: alex, can you include the audit log retention policy file (retention_policy_v2.pdf) and a redacted exemplar audit log showing the last-access events (no PII)? customer asked explicitly to see retention durations and export controls.

alex-security: yes — retention_policy_v2.pdf in the S3 bundle. I'll add a redacted CSV sample of audit entries and an HSM attestation statement signed by our vendor. I'll add short notes mapping CAIQ questions to our docs.

jordan-ps: once the artefact is ready, I'll route to legal for sign-off. maria, if customer agrees to Mon EOD extension we'll have time to finalize.

maria-cs: pinged the AE for the extension; also asked the customer for any more request-ids and their billing invoice number for the spike. they responded with invoice inv_20240611_77 and said they saw a 3x token charge during the 13:40–13:55 window.

sam-eng: billing spike likely from retries + failed auth combined with client retry logic. will pull token usage and retry counts for that window and cross-check with customer invoice. suggest we block automatic retries for 401 responses for 1 hour while we roll the hotfix.

alex-security: agree on blocking automatic retries for 401s temporarily. I'll notify Ops to hold any automated billing reconciliations until we confirm root cause.

maria-cs: action items:
- sam-eng: hotfix branch + metrics + log dump (ETA 2h)
- alex-security: assemble CAIQ artefact bundle + retention docs + attestation (ETA EOD)
- jordan-ps: request extension and coordinate legal (ETA EOD)
- maria-cs: keep customer updated and collect any additional request-ids/invoices

maria-cs: tagging this thread for follow-up. I'll update with the extension response and the incident number. :thumbsup:
